fee_notes: Royalty is 4.5% of Gross Sales, paid weekly via EFT. Marketing Fund Contribution is 1% of Gross Sales (weekly), with franchisor right to increase to 3% on 30 days' notice. Local Advertising is an additional 1% of Gross Sales paid monthly directly to advertising suppliers. Grand Opening Advertising is a one-time $5,500 fee. Merchant and Gift Card Processing Fees are approximately $75/month plus transaction fees of approximately 4.7-6%. Waitlist Management System is approximately $25-$60/month. Olo online ordering and delivery services are approximately $100-$1,500/month depending on volume. Software License Fees (Ctuit, Toast POS or Aloha POS, QSR Automations, Connected Payments, Playerlync) are approximately $250-$1,100/month depending on modules selected. Late Payment Interest is 18% of overdue amount calculated daily or maximum permitted by law, whichever is less. Transfer Fee is $10,000. Renewal Fee is $5,000. Substitute General Manager Training is $3,000. Food Safety & Sanitation Inspections are approximately $300 per inspection (currently three per year).
raw_excerpt:
Royalty | 4.5% of Gross Sales(2) | Weekly | Amounts due will be withdrawn by electronic funds transfer ("EFT") or other methods we periodically specify
Marketing Fund Contribution | 1% of Gross Sales | Weekly | We have the right to increase this amount to 3% upon 30 days' notice to you
Local Advertising | 1% of Gross Sales | Monthly | You pay directly subject to our approval. Payable to suppliers of advertising services. Within 30 days after the end of each month, you must provide us with an accounting of your expenditures in a form prescribed by us.
Grand Opening Advertising | $5,500 | Between 1 week prior to opening and 8 weeks after opening | You must perform a grand opening of your Franchised Restaurant at time of beginning operations or if you relocate.
Renewal Fee | $5,000 | Upon signing renewal documents | Payable if you and we elect to renew and enter into a Renewal Franchise Agreement
Audit Expenses | Cost of audit plus interest | As invoiced | Payable only if the audit shows an understatement in amounts due of at least 3%
Late Payment Interest | 18% of the overdue amount, calculated daily, or the maximum rate permitted by law, whichever is less | After due date | Applies to all Royalty Fees, Advertising Fund Contributions and amounts due for purchases from us or an affiliate of ours.
Black Bear Diner Gift Shop Purchases | Will vary under circumstances | As required | You must purchase these products from our approved or designated suppliers in order to meet anticipated customer demand.
Merchant and Gift Card Processing Fees | Approximately $75 per month plus transaction fee ranging from approximately 4.7-6%. | Monthly | This fee is imposed by us but currently payable to an approved third party supplier of processing services.
Waitlist Management System | Approximately $25-$60 per month | Monthly | This fee is imposed by us but currently payable to an approved third party supplier of waitlist and queue management services.
Olo® online digital ordering and delivery services | Approximately $100 - $1,500 per month depending on the volume of online ordering. | Monthly | We require you to use an approved online ordering, currently OLO, and an approved delivery service.
Software License Fees | Approximately $250 - $1,100 depending on the modules you select | Monthly | You are currently required to license and use software including Ctuit®, Toast® POS, (or in some approved cases Aloha® POS), QSR Automations®, Connected Payments®, and Playerlync® software in the operation of your Restaurant.
Suppliers' Approval | Reasonable cost of evaluation and actual cost of test not to exceed $1,000 | Time of inspection
Reimbursement of Amounts Paid on Your Behalf | Our costs | Within 15 days after billing
Transfer Fee | $10,000 | Before transfer | This transfer fee does not apply to a transfer to an entity you own or control
Ongoing Training | You are required to pay your expenses as well as your employees' expenses in attending training | Prior to training
Substitute General Manager Training | $3,000 | At Time of Scheduling
Food Safety & Sanitation Inspections | Our expenses currently approximately $300 per inspection | Upon Demand | Currently three inspections per year.
